scope: Recorded TP2 GPU comparison; not a new packaging benchmark

metric_notes.upstream_prefill_input_tps: Total actual input tokens / full benchmark duration
metric_notes.mean_tpot_ms: Mean per-request time per output token, milliseconds; lower is better
metric_notes.actual_aggregate_output_tps: Actual total generated output tokens / full benchmark duration
